page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results position this instance in the lower performance tiers. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests place the server in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory performance is also constrained, with large-block read-only memory bandwidth falling into the bottom 10% at 20.87 GB/sec and write bandwidth in the bottom 25% at 18.81 GB/sec. Similarly, database operations and Redis SET operations register in the bottom 10% to 25% brackets.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation but highly constrained memory capacity and lower-tier benchmark results, the ecs.ic5.xlarge represents a budget-conscious option for compute-centric workloads that do not require large memory footprints. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, basic text processing, or simple task queue workers where dedicated CPU execution is preferred over shared-core burstable instances.
